items.title: Laptop connected to Wi-Fi but no internet access
items.content:
Problem: Laptop connected to Wi-Fi but no internet access on macOS. It happens on my work laptop.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Restarted the network adapter and flushed the DNS cache.

items.title: Wi-Fi connected but browser says no internet
items.content:
Problem: Wi-Fi connected but browser says no internet on Windows 11. I already restarted the device once.

Resolution: Restarted the network adapter and flushed the DNS cache.

items.title: DNS Cache Recovery - Guide 1
items.content: If Wi-Fi is connected but internet access is unavailable, open Command Prompt and run ipconfig /flushdns. Reconnect to Wi-Fi and test again.
